resolution: Fixed the crash + added the add-mesh dialog. The crash: my earlier 'placed' memo refactor dropped the required '~<version>' separator from the Scene3D.Mesh dynamicKey (it was 'studio.part0'), and the host drops/throws on a dynamicKey without '~' — added a per-part version field in studioModel (init 0, bumps on future mesh edits) and the key is now 'studio.<id>~<version>'. The dialog (AddCubeDialog in Studio.tsx, opened by the outliner +add): pick the first cube's diameter (= width = depth) and height and confirm; model.addCube builds cuboid(diameter,height,diameter). Adding does not change the grid. Bundle-clean, hot-reload.
